step_results.step_text: The original and candidate archives and build receipts exist locally
The provenance verifier runs without device access
It verifies the exact artifact source patch toolchain and build log hashes and refuses changed inputs

scenarios.scenario_name: Unauthorized or drifting transactions refuse before writes

step_results.step_text: A prepared transaction has no approval or a wrong serial boot lock hash or mount
The installer is invoked with a mocked transport
It refuses before mutation and dry run never opens a device connection

scenarios.scenario_name: Atomic replacement and explicit rollback preserve physical state

step_results.step_text: Two stock aliases have verified backups and original metadata
The transaction replaces or rolls back both aliases in a simulated filesystem
It restores mode and context hashes both aliases and remounts read only on success or failure
Runtime files match but the daemon is absent or one control screenshot is white
The acceptance checker reads offline observations and outer signoff
It refuses and only a changed boot exact fingerprint init parent and two signed lit t20 screenshots can pass
